text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 51 November 16, 1972
AUTHORIZING THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TO OBTAIN SUCH LOANS OR INCUR
INDEBTEDNESS AS MAY BE NECESSARY TO FINANCE THE ACQUISITION OF CARGO
WHEREAS, there is need to require aircrafts to enable the Government to undertake socio-economic activities
such as rescue and airlift operations during calamities, typhoon moderation projects, regional commodity
movements, and other developmental work;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1, dated September 22,
1972, do decree that the (attached Authority for the Acquisition of Cargo Aircrafts) is hereby adopted and
made a part of the Law of the Land.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
